svg.aria-label: Every design placed in space and time. Each panel is one design, in three columns by who checks conflicts: owner-decider, separate-decider, and single-decider. Its rows are places: in a node, above SQL, below SQL, below the access methods, below the buffer pool. Its columns are four steps in sequence. S is the split point, O the ordering point, R the replication point, and a green band marks when the transaction executes, which has no fixed place. Owner-deciders split first, then order and replicate. Separate-deciders order first: Calvin before it executes, DSQL after, and Oracle RAC while it runs. Single-deciders order in the one writer while it executes.
svg.text: Every design in space and time
requests reach the owner of each slice
the transaction runs: no fixed place
Postgres's WAL instead of MySQL's binlog
rows: where; columns: in what order
the nodes that hold the data decide
nodes that don't hold the data decide
Leaderless, out of scope: replicas settle writes later
